"""Cost sensitivity for outcome flips: a flip that moves a comparison by a full win (b wins -> a wins) costs 2 half-win units, a tie -> win costs 1.
For z-stratified pairs, the search solution x of the unit-cost problem is re-priced: cost2(x) is a verified upper bound on the minimum cost-weighted
alteration cost (the solution is a verified reversal), and k (the unit-cost count) a lower bound on it (every alteration costs at least 1).
usage: 11_sensitivity.py UNIT [--npairs 40]   -> $OUT/sens/cost2_<unit>.parquet"""
import argparse, os, sys
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src")); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import btlib as B, analysis as A
from core01 import OUT, get, stratified

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("unit"); ap.add_argument("--npairs", type=int, default=40)
a = ap.parse_args()
P = A.Prepared(get(a.unit))
ty = B.Types(P.g, "flip")
th, H = B.fit(P.g, P.cnt, P.theta, return_H=True)
order = np.argsort(-th)
Hinv = np.linalg.inv(H)
pairs = [(order[r], order[s]) for r in range(P.M) for s in range(r + 1, P.M)]
rows = []
for x_, (i, j) in enumerate(pairs):  # cheap first pass for z to stratify
    d = B.make_d(P.M, i, j)
    rows.append(dict(a=i, b=j, z_fisher=(d @ th) / np.sqrt(d @ Hinv @ d)))
sel = stratified(rows, a.npairs)
w = np.where(np.tile([2.0, 1.0, 2.0, 1.0], P.g.P) > 0, np.tile([2.0, 1.0, 2.0, 1.0], P.g.P), 1.0)  # kinds b2a,t2a,a2b,t2b
out = []
for t in sel:
    i, j = rows[t]["a"], rows[t]["b"]
    d = B.make_d(P.M, i, j)
    res = B.kstar(P.g, ty, P.cnt, d, th0=th)
    if not np.isfinite(res["k_ver"]) or res["x"] is None:
        continue
    x = np.asarray(res["x"], float)
    out.append(dict(unit=a.unit, a=i, b=j, z_fisher=rows[t]["z_fisher"], k=res["k_ver"], cost2_upper=float((w * x).sum()), N=P.N))
os.makedirs(f"{OUT}/sens", exist_ok=True)
pd.DataFrame(out).to_parquet(f"{OUT}/sens/cost2_{a.unit.replace(':', '_')}.parquet")
print(a.unit, len(out), "pairs; median cost2/k", np.median([o["cost2_upper"] / o["k"] for o in out]))
